correctness.rationale: The all-plane incidence identities BB^T=B^TB=sI+J force exact adjacency Jordan forms on constant and zero-sum sectors. Direct block transfer to T via T+T^-1=diag(A,A) proves the (X+1)^2, (X+1)^4 and (X^2+X+1)^2 temporal modules, including field extension. Polynomial gcd yields the fixed-point formula for every t and primitive-period counts by Möbius inversion; exact positive r guarantees period 12 in the even-order case. The monomial coefficient argument derives the known Desarguesian rank. Exact binary matrix and independent vertex-update programs were executed and passed, with finite-test boundaries stated.

value.rationale: This resolves a complete, naturally defined recurrent-state census on Levi graphs of arbitrary finite projective planes, including non-Desarguesian ones. It reveals a sharp 6-versus-12 period parity boundary and exactly encodes a meaningful geometric coding invariant (binary incidence rank) in a first-return fixed-point population. The explicit Desarguesian subfamily and rank-sensitive non-Desarguesian formula support future comparison without claiming a classification of available ranks.
